pathAssistantSteps.info:
Assigned - space is assigned to a Quote or Opportunity.

  • Soft hold for the linked deal
  • If the deal falls through, return to Available

Available - space is unallocated and ready for sale.

  • Confirm space type (Cabinet/Cage/Data Hall), capacity, and power specs
  • Unit is visible in feasibility checks for new Opportunities

Installed - customer is live in this space.

  • Customer has physical access
  • Monitor contract end date for renewal planning

Pending Available - space is transitioning back to the available pool.

  • Previous customer contract ended or space was released
  • Ops to verify space is physically cleared before marking Available

ROFR - Right of First Refusal active.

  • Existing customer has contractual right to this space
  • Cannot sell without offering to ROFR holder first

Reserved - Order confirmed, awaiting provisioning.

  • Space is hard-allocated to the Order
  • Ops to begin physical provisioning

Sold - space is contractually committed.

  • Linked to an Order Item
  • Service Commencement Date set
  • Customer billing begins on SCD

Stranded - space cannot be sold in current state.

  • Physical or infrastructure issue prevents allocation
  • Ops to investigate and resolve before returning to Available
